# Third-party files served by the map pages

| Path | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `maplibre-gl-6.16.0/` | MapLibre GL JS 6.16.0, npm `maplibre-gl` (dist build, unmodified) | BSD-3-Clause, see `LICENSE.txt` |
| `pmtiles-4.5.0/pmtiles.js` | PMTiles 4.5.0, npm `pmtiles` (UMD build, unmodified) | BSD-3-Clause, Protomaps LLC |
| `glyphs/` | Noto Sans Regular, Medium and Italic glyph ranges from protomaps/basemaps-assets | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Noto fonts) |
| `../map-style.json` | Generated from npm `@protomaps/basemaps` 5.7.2 ("light" flavor recoloured as WingView's warm atlas palette; icon layers removed) | BSD-3-Clause, Protomaps LLC |

Map data: Protomaps Basemap v4 from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) and Natural Earth, attributed on every map.
